newsitem.title: USA: Whitehall wins contract from U.S. Air Force.
newsitem.headline: Whitehall wins contract from U.S. Air Force.

text.p: Whitehall Corp said it won a U.S. Air Force contract for maintenance of C-130 aircraft that could exceed $100 million over five years if all of its renewal options are exercised.
The company did not specify whether the $100 million contract would mean $100 million in revenues, and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
The contract was awarded to Whitehall's Aero Corp unit, the company said.
The company had about $70 million in revenues for fiscal 1996.
